title: Products
headline: Tools for building useful things.
home_title: One product family. More ways to build.
intro: Build AI applications, coordinate software development, map your ideas and print from web apps. Explore xDev products for the work you need to do.
connection_title: Each product serves a part of the work.
connection_text: AI Studio helps build AI applications. Hive coordinates teams and coding agents across AI SDLC. xDraft turns ideas into mind maps, flowcharts and architecture diagrams on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Browser Print lets web apps print each document on the right printer. Choose the tool that fits your needs and deployment environment.

products.name: XDev AI Studio
products.description: Connect models, knowledge, and tools to build AI assistants and workflows for your work.

products.name: xDev Hive
products.description: Connect teams, coding agents, and repositories: coordinate tasks, track runs, review results, and preserve lessons.

products.name: xDraft by xDev
products.description: A native AI diagram studio for Mac, iPhone and iPad: mind maps, flowcharts and architecture diagrams with C4, deployment and sequence views, on-device AI and no data collected.

products.name: xDev Browser Print
products.description: A Chrome extension and TypeScript SDK that let web apps print prescriptions, invoices and labels on the printer set for each document type, with no backend.
